notes.title: Lighting Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/6a2cec6d0ad9679ce59473103e99058ae96e6491.gif
Hello all!
We've been listening to your feedback, and it's clear you all want to see more in PolyZen Drive! So, we put on our headlamps and dove into the lighting system to bring you some bright new changes. Let’s light up those night drives!

Changelog:

 Can See Now:
Late-night drives felt more like driving through a black hole. But not anymore! We've supercharged the headlights so you can actually see where you’re going. We revamped the light falloff logic to brighten up large areas with less light power. No more overlapping headlights blinding you or turning the game into a light show.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/4e56f53ef2523c59b4d329848366e160b3528c60.gif
 Environment Lights:
Sunlight, streetlights, tunnel lights, and every other light you can think of got a makeover. Vehicle brake lights, blinkers, and reverse lights have all been tuned up. The nights have never looked so good!

 Vehicle Textures:
Our cars are looking spiffier than ever. We’ve adjusted all vehicle materials to fit the new lighting system, making every ride more detailed and polished. Your wheels have never looked this good!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/40e6f1e31c12b01c2d7d4bbda4aae836b617bbf6.png
 Better Shadows:
Say goodbye to those jittery shadows caused by the sun’s dynamic movement. Shadows are now smoother, higher quality, and look just as good as the rest of the game.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/ebfa20ae6c1ff5525283c2cdb6ebdcdc33c9903d.gif
 Language Support:
We've gone global! Thanks to @Hiro from our Discord server, we now support Japanese. Plus, we’ve added Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Polish, Ukrainian, and Korean with AI translations. It’s a PolyZen world out there!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/bc2bb8e369291b0e3d7d39bb76c2f452be0cdfcb.gif

Thank you for your ongoing support and fantastic feedback. We’re committed to making PolyZen Drive the best it can be, and we couldn’t do it without you.

See you on the road—enjoy the drive and keep those headlights shining bright!

Happy driving!
Your PolyZen Drive Team

notes.title: Cruise Together: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Introducing the Multiplayer Update for PolyZen Drive! Now, you and your friends can hit the road together and embark on exciting journeys through our beautifully crafted landscapes. 
Here's what's new:


 Drive with Friends: Invite your friends and cruise together in multiplayer mode. Enjoy the company, share your favorite tunes from our diverse radio stations, and create unforgettable memories on the road.
 Customizable Multiplayer Sessions: Create your own multiplayer sessions and tailor the experience to your liking. Choose from various game modes, adjust settings, and enjoy a personalized driving experience with your friends.
 Seamless Integration: Switch seamlessly between single-player and multiplayer modes. Start a session with friends directly from the in-game menu and explore the open world together without any interruptions.
 Community Connection: Connect with fellow drivers from around the world in our vibrant community. Share tips, organize group rides, and immerse yourself in the camaraderie of multiplayer driving.

Multiplayer Showcase Footage:
[previewyoutube=KPig72fC01k;full][/previewyoutube]

Other Changes:

 Main and in-game Menu Changes: Menu UIs are optimized and enhanced
 Weather Overhaul: Weather, fog, effects and various visual aspects of the atmosphere system have been improved. Disliked fog colors have been removed. New color palettes added. New cloud types added. Texture quality increased.

What's To Come?

 Huge open-world style map to enjoy with multiplayer
 Mini-games, stunts, jumps etc. for the new map
 Off-road driving support (visual effects, sounds, and drivable off road areas)


Get ready to hit the road with friends and experience the thrill of multiplayer driving in PolyZen Drive! Join the fun, share the joy, and create unforgettable memories together. See you on the road!
Join our discord server => PolyZen Drive Discord Server
Subscribe to us on Youtube => Youtube Channel

notes.title: Police and Drive Update
notes.content:
We're thrilled to present our Police and Drive Update, bringing you closer to the heart of PolyZen Drive! As developers deeply committed to our community, nothing fills us with more joy than sharing our latest strides with you. Let's embark on this journey together and delve into the thrilling new features!

Changelog:
Hot Pursuit
Experience the adrenaline rush of our brand-new Police Pursuit mode! Drive over the speed limit, and watch as the cops start to chase you. Evade capture by racing through bustling traffic, outmaneuvering the law in a heart-pounding chase!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/9ab5cf266159505b70b77888126f8500104ca950.gif
Beat the Clock
Test your skills against the tick-tocking timer in our electrifying Time Trial mode! Speed through checkpoints, shatter records, and show the world who's boss on the leaderboard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/160b5d98ad940d6270c15de40eadd6fd3f8ed644.png
Fresh Rides, Fresh Vibes
Buckle up and cruise in style with three sleek new cars added to our lineup! Each with its unique style, and one even winks at you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/b180831bf9b19a1423603fadea814722a48df45f.png
New Cozy Menu
We've given our main menu a cozy makeover, making it easier than ever to navigate and dive into the action of PolyZen Drive.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/b52549e9ceebd5398fd5d3a3d3c2864da6c71e53.png
Groove on the Go
Pump up the jams with our latest selection of tunes, made by our lovely community. We've added a brand new radio channel called "Discord Radio," filled with awesome tunes made by or sent by our players through our Discord Server.
Our first jams:
[olist]Age Into Peace by Curly
Celestial Dreamscape Symphony Ethereal Echoes of the Neon Nebula by Curly
Raspberry Starfruit by Curly
Scratch The Surface by Curly
Drowning by Pseudosentiment[/olist]
Other Changes
More freedom in camera mode (Independent movement with WASD keys)
Functional manual clutch
Turn on/off speedometer UI
Other bug fixes (We receive bug reports on our Discord Server and hot-fix them ASAP)

Future Plans!
Along with these changes, we want to show you what the future for PolyZen Drive looks like. Here are some concept pictures of how the future looks for us. Share your ideas and let us know what you think about these concept pictures. Get involved in development via our Discord Server!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/ed6c24b7f1b7643fc6e3c4fc87766c15b30935d4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/e9f34ec618ab9989b004dba82719de674d99c98d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/acb04d07943d0b683429341470ada706d313c862.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/20effcd1a1bbf67f0e664f1daee090a181833522.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/295d06ef758c30699f4f8a9153c049164ce9a354.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/45399fb032ad4038e0bd3945a3ac3d7a80e0af9b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/a98d667abdf20ec8acb97087e4b27a0846793daf.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/31762de9ea0e962d1d5290d1ee543d23bb6875f6.png
Watch as we make our models:
[previewyoutube=zbqLFNbDASg;full][/previewyoutube]
That's all for now. Update now and get ready to kick your driving experience into high gear with the Police and Drive Update!

notes.title: Weekly Update #2
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!
Welcome to our weekly update #2 for PolyZen Drive. 
We introduce lots of technical and visual improvements in this update, so fasten your seatbelts!

Changelog:
French support!
  * The game is now fully playable in French, thanks to our players Midö and Linkinito for the translation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/91ee37a2b9604db393e1b4576313fe20f7c4e6f9.png

 Input System Overhaul!
 * We completely remade our input system. Now almost all gamepads/racing wheels should be supported by the game. 
* Gamepad inputs are now also re-mappable.
 * Tested with G920, G29, T300rs, Thrustmaster Tx, Xbox series controller, xbox one controller, Logitech controllers, generic gamepads
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/6457b6ea1301fcc6dda016c26fa65f606a1fc663.png

Vehicle Customizations!
  * All vehicles can now be painted!
* Windows tint options added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/bf600f9a2bec515e5c93772fcaea8c32b7a70c95.png

Prettier Achievements!
  * Remade all achievement logos.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/c1622bace556ce3b610ff4eda24d434d04eb8362.png

More character customizations
  * Hair/facial color options for the character added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/cf868c664f01505ce36f8cd3bbf27ac3190a6ecc.png

Enhanced photo mode
  * Camera tint and outline options are added to the photo mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/f39875e6c923d642532bda8251134e59c706358c.png


That's all for this patch. Thank you for your continued interest in our game. Stay tuned for future updates.
Join our discord server => PolyZen Drive Discord Server
Subscribe to us on Youtube => Youtube Channel

Cheers.

notes.title: Weekly Update #1
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!
Welcome to our first weekly update for PolyZen Drive. 
We're committed to delivering regular, smaller updates to address bugs and add minor features while continuously enhancing the game. Many of the features added in these patches were suggested by our players on our Discord channel and Steam community page. Be sure to follow these platforms to stay updated on our roadmap.

Changelog:
Hungarian support!
  * The game is now fully playable in Hungarian, thanks to our player JeGgeSs™ for translation assistance.

 Windshield wipers!
 * Windshield wipers have been added to all cars and can be enabled or disabled through the in-game options menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/8466fe5d974c00f1821617ce823298e0a4e9fc4c.gif

Enhanced photo mode
  * The camera can now move up/down and zoom in/out in photo mode.
  * Time of day can be changed while in camera mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/f6826624d12db778c5b842337eca80229027ba5e.png

Enhanced cruise control
  * Cruise control now includes the option to maintain the current speed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771254/a21d490c79e734613d1061b6ddc3cb45b3426615.png

Reduced likelihood of green haze/fog during morning weather
  * Following community feedback, we've significantly decreased the chance of this weather event occurring.

That's all for this patch. Thank you for your continued interest in our game. Stay tuned for future updates.
Join our discord server => PolyZen Drive Discord Server
Subscribe to us on Youtube => Youtube Channel

Cheers.
